title: RoboSPA: Can VLA Models Go Beyond Simple Scenes and Short-Horizon Tasks?
abstract: arXiv:2609.05324v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown promising progress in language-conditioned robotic manipulation. However, existing datasets and benchmarks mainly evaluate task completion under predefined settings, offering limited insight into model reasoning under increasing spatial and procedural complexity. We introduce \textbf{RoboSPA} (\textbf{Robo}t \textbf{S}patial-\textbf{P}rocedural \textbf{A}ssessment), a large-scale robotic manipulation dataset and benchmark for diagnosing embodied reasoning in VLA models. \texttt{RoboSPA} focuses on two core dimensions, Fine-Grained Spatial Reasoning and Long-Horizon Procedural Planning, covering 10 task categories and 56 base tasks. Each task is instantiated across five difficulty levels, yielding 280 variants with increasing spatial ambiguity and procedural complexity. translated_title: RoboSPA：VLA模型能否超越简单场景和短时程任务？
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在语言条件化的机器人操作领域展现了可喜的进展。然而，现有的数据集和基准主要在预定义设置下评估任务完成情况，对于模型在空间和程序复杂性不断增加时的推理能力提供的洞察有限。我们提出了RoboSPA（机器人空间-程序评估），这是一个用于诊断VLA模型具身推理能力的大规模机器人操作数据集和基准。RoboSPA聚焦于两个核心维度：细粒度空间推理和长时程程序规划，涵盖10个任务类别和56个基础任务。每个任务在五个难度级别上进行实例化，产生280个具有递增空间模糊性和程序复杂性的任务变体。我们收集了跨越多种机器人形态和多样化场景的52.7万条轨迹。除了二元成功率之外，RoboSPA...
tldr: 提出了RoboSPA，一个用于诊断VLA模型具身推理能力的大规模机器人操作数据集与基准，通过细粒度空间推理和长时程程序规划两个核心维度、280个跨五个难度级别的任务变体以及52.7万条轨迹，系统评估模型在空间与程序复杂性递增场景下的推理能力。
en_tdlr: Introduces RoboSPA, a large-scale robotic manipulation dataset and benchmark for diagnosing embodied reasoning in VLA models, featuring fine-grained spatial reasoning and long-horizon procedural planning dimensions with 280 task variants across five difficulty levels and 527K collected trajectories.
